quotes.quote: GENEA mutation defines Fixture Entity One when the blast count is at least 20 per cent; a blast count of 10 to 19 per cent is assigned to Fixture Entity Two. The criterion is defeated where a fixture-defining fusion is present.
GENEB mutation refines an existing category but does not move it.
GENEA | favourable in the fixture cohort | multivariable-adjusted for age and blast count
GENEC | no independent effect after adjustment | multivariable-adjusted
GENEC was reported as adverse in an earlier fixture series on univariable analysis only.
The GENEA mutation is a validated fixture follow-up marker and should be tracked with a high-sensitivity assay.
GENEB is not validated as a stand-alone follow-up marker in this fixture setting.

A near-heterozygous loss-of-function GENED variant with a lower-burden second event is the characteristic fixture predisposition architecture, and warrants confirmation on a non-haematopoietic specimen.
